evals.name: limit-parcel-creation
evals.prompt: Only one ParcelOpened may appear per parcel. Write and race the model-bound rule.
assertions: Places Unique on the event type, not a property.
Races two appends for one source and identifies the losing constraint by name.
Checks one stored fact and success for a different source.

evals.name: reserve-shared-handle
evals.prompt: Two accounts may not claim the same handle. Why is a per-source occurrence limit insufficient?
assertions: Names the property-ownership violation observed by the loser.
Constrains the shared handle value rather than event count under one source.
Tests conflicting claims using different source IDs.

evals.name: demonstrate-preflight-race
evals.prompt: Our validator queries availability before commit. Demonstrate what it cannot guarantee.
assertions: Checks stored history contains only the winning claim.
Allows both preflight checks to observe availability.
Requires kernel enforcement at append and does not count a validation refusal as proof.
